Values used

Simply supported, uniform load, repetitive member factor 1.15, dry service, normal temperature. Deflection uses live load only. Rafter spans are horizontal projection with no ceiling attached. Design values are from the NDS Supplement (Southern Pine Table 4B, 2013 and later values; Douglas Fir-Larch Table 4A with size factor). Does not check bearing, notches, holes, point loads, snow drift, wind uplift or lateral support.
